not_outs.label: NO
not_outs.desc: Not-out innings (retired hurt counts as not out).

balls.label: Balls
balls.desc: Balls faced (no-balls count, wides do not).

average.label: Avg
average.desc: Runs per dismissal. Shown as - when never dismissed.

boundary_pct.label: Bdry %
boundary_pct.desc: Share of runs scored in boundaries.

dot_pct.label: Dot %
dot_pct.desc: Share of balls faced that scored no runs off the bat.

balls_per_dismissal.label: Balls/Dis
balls_per_dismissal.desc: Dismissal frequency: balls faced per dismissal.

team_run_contribution_pct.label: Team Run %
team_run_contribution_pct.desc: Player runs / team innings totals (incl. extras) in innings batted.

non_boundary_pct.label: Running %
non_boundary_pct.desc: Runs scored by running between the wickets / total runs.

runs_per_ball.label: Runs/Ball
runs_per_ball.desc: Scoring efficiency: runs per ball faced.

consistency_index.label: Consistency
consistency_index.desc: 0-100. 50% x share of meaningful innings (20+ runs, or 10+ at SR 150+) + 50% x (1 - capped coefficient of variation of scores). Min 5 innings.

impact_innings_pct.label: Impact Inns %
impact_innings_pct.desc: Share of innings with 15+ runs AND 8+ runs above the expected score for the balls faced (competition, phase and position adjusted).

runs_per_dismissal.label: Runs/Dis
runs_per_dismissal.desc: Runs per dismissal; not-outs do not add a dismissal.

runs_above_expected.label: Runs +/-
runs_above_expected.desc: Runs minus the runs an average batter would score from the same balls (same competition, phase and position group).

sr_above_avg.label: SR vs Avg
sr_above_avg.desc: Strike rate minus the expected strike rate for the same competition, phase and batting-position group.

powerplay_aggression_index.label: PP Aggression
powerplay_aggression_index.desc: 100 = average. 50% SR vs expected + 30% boundary rate vs expected + 20% dismissal-risk factor, overs 1-6. Min 30 balls.

middle_over_control_index.label: Middle Control
middle_over_control_index.desc: 100 = average. 40% SR vs expected + 35% dot-ball avoidance + 25% boundary rate, overs 7-15. Min 30 balls.

death_finishing_index.label: Death Finishing
death_finishing_index.desc: 100 = average. 50% SR vs expected + 30% boundary rate + 20% dismissal-risk factor, overs 16-20. Min 30 balls.

chase_contribution_pct.label: Chase Run %
chase_contribution_pct.desc: Runs / team runs in all chases batted.

chase_success_contribution_pct.label: Won Chase %
chase_success_contribution_pct.desc: Runs / team runs in successful chases.

chase_failure_contribution_pct.label: Lost Chase %
chase_failure_contribution_pct.desc: Runs / team runs in unsuccessful chases.

pressure_avg.label: Pressure Avg
pressure_avg.desc: Runs per dismissal in pressure situations.

pressure_sr_delta.label: Pressure Delta
pressure_sr_delta.desc: Pressure SR minus the expected SR of comparable pressure deliveries.

late_over_scoring_efficiency.label: Late-over Eff.
late_over_scoring_efficiency.desc: 100 = average. Death-over runs / expected death-over runs.

runs_conceded.label: Runs
runs_conceded.desc: Runs charged to the bowler (bat runs + wides + no-balls).

maidens.label: Mdns
maidens.desc: Maiden overs (six legal balls, no runs charged).

dot_balls.label: Dots
dot_balls.desc: Legal balls with no runs charged to the bowler.

wicket_contribution_pct.label: Wkt Contrib %
wicket_contribution_pct.desc: Bowler wickets / team bowler-credited wickets in innings bowled.

dot_ball_share_pct.label: Dot Share %
dot_ball_share_pct.desc: Bowler dot balls / team dot balls in innings bowled.

boundary_prevention_rate.label: Bdry Prevention %
boundary_prevention_rate.desc: Share of legal balls that did not go for a boundary.

runs_saved.label: Runs Saved
runs_saved.desc: Expected runs conceded (same competition and phase) minus actual runs conceded.

economy_advantage.label: Econ Advantage
economy_advantage.desc: Expected economy (competition and phase) minus actual economy.

pressure_bowling_index.label: Pressure Bowling
pressure_bowling_index.desc: 100 = average. 60% runs vs expected + 40% wickets vs expected, in pressure situations. Min 24 balls.

bowling_consistency.label: Consistency
bowling_consistency.desc: 0-100. 50% share of spells (12+ balls) at or better than expected runs or with 2+ wickets + 50% stability of economy.

death_over_effectiveness.label: Death Effectiveness
death_over_effectiveness.desc: 100 = average. Death-over economy (40%), wickets (30%), dots (15%) and boundaries (15%) vs expected. Min 24 balls.

pressure_economy_delta.label: Pressure Delta
pressure_economy_delta.desc: Expected pressure economy minus actual (positive is better).

pressure_wicket_frequency.label: Pressure Balls/Wkt
pressure_wicket_frequency.desc: Balls per wicket in pressure situations.

win_rate.label: Win %
win_rate.desc: Matches won (ties = half) / decided matches played.

wins.label: Wins
wins.desc: Matches won while in the playing XI.

winning_run_share_pct.label: Win Run Share %
winning_run_share_pct.desc: Runs in wins / team runs in those same wins.

winning_wicket_share_pct.label: Win Wkt Share %
winning_wicket_share_pct.desc: Wickets in wins / team bowler wickets in those same wins.

wins_present.label: Wins Present
wins_present.desc: Wins where the player was in the XI.

wins_significant.label: Significant Wins
wins_significant.desc: Wins with a significant contribution (20+ runs and 20%+ of team runs, 2+ wickets, 5+ runs saved from 18+ balls, or match score 8+).

wins_exceptional.label: Match-winning
wins_exceptional.desc: Wins where the player had the team's best match score (runs above expected + runs saved + wicket value) of at least 15.

match_winning_innings.label: MW Innings
match_winning_innings.desc: Team's most valuable batting innings in a win: 25+ runs and 12+ runs above expected.

match_winning_bowling.label: MW Spells
match_winning_bowling.desc: Team's most valuable spell in a win: value 10+ with 2+ wickets or 8+ runs saved.

overall_impact.label: Overall Impact
overall_impact.desc: EXPERIMENTAL. Weighted mean of applicable component percentiles (batting 40, bowling 35, pressure 15; fielding unavailable).

pei.label: Position Effectiveness
pei.desc: EXPERIMENTAL percentile within position group: run production, team contribution, scoring efficiency and pressure performance.

pressure_partnership_contribution_pct.label: Pressure Stand %
pressure_partnership_contribution_pct.desc: Share of runs in pressure partnerships scored by the player.
